title: Programmer Art+ Add-on Pack
description: additional programmer art-styled textures that I've made over time. requires programmer art+!
body:
this pack is an add-on pack for [Programmer Art+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-plus) that programmerifies more things. check the gallery to see some examples!

---

of note is that I specifically replace:

bundles

shroomlights

some sherds

because I'm not fond of them! I do, however, heavily urge you to edit or replace anything in this pack that YOU aren't fond of. paint.net is free! aseprite is cheap (and free if you know how to build it)!

---

recommended packs:

[Programmer Art+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-plus) (of course)

one of either [Beta 1.7.3 Lighting](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/beta-1-7-3-lighting/) or [Lightmap Fixer](https://modrinth.com/shader/lightmap-fixer) (these are vanilla shaders and thus don't need mods! Beta 1.7.3 Lighting brings back the old lighting, while Lightmap Fixer keeps the modern warm lighting, without it being TOO warm. check its gallery for details!)

various [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/) packs (e.g. Poppy to Rose, one of the classic sheep ones (I personally use Kinda Classic Sheep), and Bed Icons)

[Good Ol' Ghasts](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/good-ol-ghasts/)

---

make sure to have this pack above Programmer Art+, and both packs above Default Programmer Art!
